as_told.title: Analysts found odd heavy-element atomic arrangements in recovered material

plain: A former US intelligence officer named David Grusch, who has spoken publicly about hidden government UFO programmes, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he talked to people who had analysed what he calls "the real deal stuff", material said to come from non-human craft. He says it is very strange, made of heavy, rare elements such as europium and californium, which he names in one of the two times the clip is aired. If true, it would mean real samples of such material are being studied in secret.
